content.title: UGC Review | Unboxing to Use Test
content.summary: Start with the reviewer and unopened product in the same frame. After a complete unboxing, isolate one product-specific close-up proof, perform one genuine use action, then hold the product and the resulting reaction together.

quick_start.input_format: On-screen reviewer + unopened product + complete contents reveal + one product-specific close-up proof + one genuine use + product and reaction in the same frame
quick_start.recommended_input: A ceramic artist reviews a portable pour-over kit: show the sealed box, arrange every component, use one macro close-up to prove the filter's quarter-turn lock, complete a leak-free brew and taste test, then hold up the kit with dry seams and give one restrained nod.
required_anchors: Opening scene features reviewer and unopened product in the same frame.
Show full content first, then move into details.
Only one piece of product-specific functional evidence is required.
Must complete one real-world use and retain the results.
Final scene features product and reaction after change in the same frame.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First-person or UGC-style product reviews that move from a complete unboxing to one macro close-up proof, one genuine use action, and a final frame holding the product beside the resulting reaction.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Structure a first-person product testimonial as a proof ladder: introduce the unopened object and speaker together, expose contents, isolate one tactile or functional macro proof, let the speaker perform one genuine use action, then hold the product and changed reaction together. The product claim must be earned by visible use rather than spoken hype.

invariants.rule: Open with presenter and unopened product in the same frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: A product-only beauty shot lacks testimonial ownership.

invariants.rule: Reveal the complete contents before isolating details.
invariants.purpose: Gives macro proof a known context.
invariants.ablation_failure: Macro-first editing can hide what is actually being evaluated.

invariants.rule: Choose one product-specific tactile or functional proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Generic close-ups create polish without evidence.

invariants.rule: Perform one complete use action with the outcome still visible.
invariants.purpose: Converts product state into demonstrated experience.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut before the result turns use into implication.

invariants.rule: End with product and changed human reaction readable together.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction without the object can feel unrelated or staged.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
